```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(knitr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
picks <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "picks")
roster <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "roster")
coaches <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "coaches")
teams <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "teams")
team_colors <- distinct(teams, team, color)
# Last-school rule, 2014 classes on; a draftee counts once per coach and school.
pairs <- coach_draftee_links(picks, roster, coaches, "last", 2014L) |>
  distinct(year, overall, coach_id, coach_name, team)
producers <- distinct(pairs, coach_id, coach_name)
# Programs each producing coach ran in the coaches table.
programs <- coaches |>
  filter(coach_id %in% producers$coach_id) |>
  distinct(coach_id, school) |>
  count(coach_id, name = "n_programs")
programs_table <- producers |>
  left_join(programs, by = "coach_id") |>
  count(n_programs, name = "coaches")
multi <- filter(programs, n_programs > 1)
mover_detail <- pairs |>
  filter(coach_id %in% multi$coach_id) |>
  count(coach_id, coach_name, team, name = "draftees") |>
  group_by(coach_id, coach_name) |>
  mutate(total = sum(draftees)) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# The twelve multi-program coaches with the most draftees; the rest are in the table.
top_movers <- mover_detail |>
  distinct(coach_id, total) |>
  slice_max(total, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE)
mover_plot <- mover_detail |>
  semi_join(top_movers, by = "coach_id") |>
  left_join(team_colors, by = "team") |>
  mutate(
    color = coalesce(color, "#9CA3AF"),
    coach_name = reorder(coach_name, total)
  )
p <- ggplot(mover_plot, aes(draftees, coach_name, group = team)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = color,
      tooltip = sprintf("%s at %s: %d draftees", coach_name, team, draftees),
      data_id = paste(coach_name, team)
    ),
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
    colour = "white",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(mover_plot, draftees >= 10),
    aes(label = team),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE),
    colour = "white",
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(
    title = "Do multi-program head coaches' draftees split across schools or pile up at one?",
    subtitle = "Draftees by school for head coaches who ran more than one program",
    x = "Draftees",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "coach-draftees-by-school", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: programs-table
programs_table |>
  arrange(n_programs) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("Programs coached", "Draftee-producing coaches"),
    caption = "Programs coached by each draftee-producing head coach, 2014 classes on, from the coaches table."
  )
```

#| label: card-footer

cat(card_footer())
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
